states.name: q
states.meaning: Single-bit stored state presented as output q; it is forced to 0 by synchronous active-high reset and otherwise captures d at the sampled posedge.
states.update_time: posedge clk after the sampled edge has settled

rules.condition: At the sampled posedge clk, r == 1; q is updated to 0 regardless of d.
rules.spec_quote: active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)

rules.condition: At the sampled posedge clk, r == 0; q is updated to the sampled value of d.
rules.spec_quote: Implement a simple D flip flop

reset.name: r
reset.first_released_cycle: first sampled posedge clk with r == 0; on that edge q follows d

mid: Mid changes to d or r occur after the sampled posedge and before the other edge, are carried to the start of the next row, and affect q only at the next sampled posedge.
